answer: Each identity builds a reef of three bond layers: 60 credits for 5 epochs, 120 for 10, 240 for 20. A lantern ledger lists each layer and owner key. Auditors run an echo check each epoch against the lantern ledger; a layer failing to echo, or one pledged to two identities, burns all three. 1,000 fakes lock 420,000 credits; rented reefs fail the echo since one key cannot sign two reefs. Honest agents post one reef once, reclaiming each layer.
